nodes.name: TS-1 Random fcc supercell generation
nodes.procedure: Training set TS-1 composed of chemically random and equiatomic fcc 3×3×3 cubic supercells with 108 atoms and orthogonal axes aligned with <100> directions. Total 505 supercells (54,540 atoms). Thermal expansion from 0 K lattice constant (3.526 Å) using coefficient 1.56×10⁻⁵ K⁻¹: half expanded to 300 K, half to 0.9Tm=1917 K. Thermal noise via random displacements: 75% supercells α∈[0.01,0.30), 25% α∈[0.30,0.55) where max displacement=α×d_nn/2.

nodes.name: TS-2 Monte Carlo SRO fcc
nodes.procedure: Monte Carlo simulations start from chemically random fcc structures (0 K lattice parameter 3.526 Å), run 5000 atom-swap attempts at 500 K. Five independent simulations performed. From each simulation, 101 configurations extracted evenly spaced at 50-step intervals for TS-2 creation. Same thermal expansion/vibration treatment as TS-1.

nodes.source_text: The Monte Carlo simulations started from chemically random structures with 0 K lattice parameter (3.526 Å) and ran for a total of 5000 atom-swap attempts at a temperature of 500 K. Five independent simulations were performed and 101 configurations evenly spaced in intervals of 50 steps were extracted from each for the creation of TS-2.

nodes.name: TS-3 Liquid MD configurations
nodes.procedure: Molecular dynamics simulation of CrCoNi liquid phase at 1800 K, zero external pressure. Setup: 72 atoms randomly placed in cubic box (volume/atom=14.83 Å³, min distance=2.11 Å to avoid overlap). Run 80 ps (3 fs timestep): 3 ps equilibration, then 752 snapshots extracted every 75 fs. Augments TS-2.
